Name: Toddler Outfits
Author: xaandiir
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/LxrQEW2.gif[/img][/center][center]﻿[/center][center][b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO[/b]

This mod allows you to change the clothes of your toddlers from onesies to actual outfits.
You can change one of the children's outfits or both.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Choose ONE of the 5 outfit options for each of the four baby folders
- Copy and paste each of these options (remember: 4 TOTAL. One for each baby) in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

*Not compatible with Babies Take After Spouses; might consider an additional pack for that mod.

[u][b]Feel free to ask if you have any questions![/b][/u][/center]
